title: Fibonacci
description: Write a function that returns the nth Fibonacci number. The Fibonacci sequence starts with 0 and 1, and each subsequent number is the sum of the two before it: 0, 1, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 13, 21... So fibonacci(0) = 0, fibonacci(1) = 1, fibonacci(6) = 8.
instructions: Complete the fibonacci function so it returns the correct nth Fibonacci number.
hints: The first two values are already set: fibonacci(0) = 0 and fibonacci(1) = 1.
Each subsequent number is the sum of the two numbers before it.
Try using a loop with two variables tracking the previous two values.
